data.define: Used to react when something is awkward, embarrassing or a bad idea.

misuse.text: Don't tell your host 'big yikes' about dinner.

data.l1_hook: Mang vớ với dép xỏ ngón? Thiệt hả?
data.l1_ex: Vớ với dép xỏ ngón? Big yikes.

native.tip: “big yikes” = Ngại quá, tệ thật. Ví dụ: “Socks with sandals? Big yikes.”
native.caption:
“big yikes” nghĩa là gì?
“big yikes” = Ngại quá, tệ thật.
Ví dụ: “Socks with sandals? Big yikes.” (Vớ với dép xỏ ngón? Big yikes.)
